metric_definitions.time_to_outcome_minutes: Simulated minutes elapsed from first scenario turn to final escalation.
metric_definitions.share_resolved_without_takeover: One confirmed driver booking divided by three driver-thread outcomes; escalated and unfinished threads are not counted as resolved.
metric_definitions.options_later_infeasible: Initially shown options that were no longer AVAILABLE after the competing hold.
metric_definitions.clarification_turns: Agent turns explicitly asking for shipment identity, ETA, or delay meaning.
metric_definitions.slot_utilisation: Live appointments (seeded plus scenario-created) divided by all slots in the snapshot.
metric_definitions.priority_policy_violations: No dispatch-reordering decision occurs in this scenario; zero violations were observed.
